messages:
john_acme: hey support — after we renamed a tool in our registry yesterday, all tool calls started failing for our clients. example error: 'tool_not_found: requested tool \"fetchUser\" not found'. we renamed from fetch_user -> fetchUser. any ideas? we're blocked in prod.
support_sara: hi @john_acme — sorry about that. can you paste the request payload and the exact error?
john_acme: here's the request we send: ```json
{"model":"redwood-august","input":"get user","tool_call":{"name":"fetchUser","args":"{\"id\":\"123\"}"}}
``` and the error from the runtime: `rpc error: code=3 desc=\'tool lookup failed: name=fetchUser not found in registry\'`
support_sara: thanks. quick q: are you on Hosted or Private? did you rename the tool in the model/tool registry or just locally in your adapter?
john_acme: private deployment (VPC) on 2025.12 image; we renamed via the Control Plane UI. one of our backend services still calls the old snake_case name `fetch_user` though.
support_sara: hmm—there's a known replication edge where aliases sometimes don't replicate to private lanes if there are transient failures. can you try the original name `fetch_user` as a temporary workaround? i'll start pulling sync logs.
john_acme: tried that too, same failure. error log still says not found for both names.
noah_infra: cc @ashley_eng — looking at the private bridge logs, saw a 404 from registry-sync for acme-corp around 2025-12-01T03:14Z. seems partial replication: main entries present but alias table missing. grabbing more traces now.
deploy-bot: registry-sync v2 triggered for customer acme-corp at 2025-12-01T03:20Z — status: partial success (missing aliases) :warning:
ashley_eng: we pushed an alias lowercasing normalization in the replication pipeline last month, but older records with mixed-case may have been filtered. i'll take this. @support_sara — can you capture the request-id and headers so we can trace the failed lookup?
support_sara: got it. request-id: 01F9abc123; headers included X-Customer-ID: acme-corp. attaching the body above. temporary mitigation: we can add an alias mapping in the Control Plane to map `fetchUser` -> `fetch_user` for you if you approve an edit.
john_acme: yes please add it. customers are waiting. timeline? :confused:
ashley_eng: i'll add a manual alias in the Control Plane and trigger an on-demand sync to the private plane. ETA ~30-45m. will update here when done.
support_sara: doing the change now. adding a note to ticket INC-20251201-45. once synced please try again and paste the new logs.
deploy-bot: registry alias added by ashley_eng. initiating one-off sync to private plane for acme-corp.
john_acme: ok trying now... success! response returned 200 and the tool executed. thank you!! :tada: 
ashley_eng: root-cause prelim: rename created a mixed-case alias and the replication normalization filtered it out. we'll implement a fix to preserve case on alias replication and add smoke tests around renames/aliases. creating ENG task RN-893.
support_sara: leaving thread open until permanent fix deployed. assigning to engineering and infra for postmortem. cc @noah_infra.
john_acme: appreciate the quick turnaround. do we need to standardize our tool names to snake_case going forward?
ashley_eng: no, there won't be a forced requirement. we'll make replication case-preserving. i'll post an update in ~2 weeks when the change is live.
support_sara: closing this slack thread for now; ticket remains open until ENG confirms permanent roll-out.
